abstract: In the last two decades European policy makers have sought to increase the use of market mechanisms in the delivery of healthcare. These reforms introduce competition and choice into previously heavily constrained environments. This leads to a set of interesting economic issues that have been addressed in a range of papers, both theoretical and empirical. This paper examines whether this popular reform model has resulted in improvements in outcomes for patients and/or taxpayers. It synthesises the existing economic analyses, highlights what is known and what is not, and signals potential next steps for economic research.
abstract_zh: 过去二十年中，欧洲政策制定者致力于在医疗服务供给中扩大市场机制的应用。这些改革将竞争与选择引入此前受到严格约束的环境，由此引发了一系列有趣的经济学议题，相关理论与实证论文已对此展开探讨。本文旨在考察这一流行改革模式是否改善了患者和/或纳税人的福利。通过综合现有经济分析，本文厘清了已知与未知领域，并指出了经济学研究的潜在未来方向。
title: Do Markets Deliver? Competition and Choice in European Healthcare Markets
title_zh: 市场能否兑现？欧洲医疗市场中的竞争与选择

abstract: The global success of online search and social media stems from free access and high quality—both enabled by a business model that monetizes personal data through targeted advertising. But does this model yield socially desirable outcomes? We examine how a global monopoly platform chooses privacy protection and service quality. Under a free‐service model, it overexploits data and underprovides quality relative to a global planner. Yet, even with distortions on both margins, stronger privacy protection alone can improve global welfare—and may even boost quality. When privacy policy is set nationally, large countries often align with global interests due to a “Brussels Effect,” where platform responses to one country's policy spill over globally. This alignment reduces the need for privacy rules in trade agreements. In contrast, ad tech taxes create “beggar‐thy‐neighbour” incentives, making them a clear case for international cooperation.
abstract_zh: 摘要 在线搜索与社交媒体的全球成功源于免费访问与高质量服务——这两者均得益于通过定向广告将个人数据货币化的商业模式。但这一模式能否产生符合社会期望的结果？我们研究了一家全球垄断平台在隐私保护与服务质量之间的权衡选择。在免费服务模式下，相较于全球规划者，该平台过度利用数据且服务质量不足。然而，即便在这两个维度均存在扭曲，仅加强隐私保护本身就能改善全球福利——甚至可能提升服务质量。当隐私政策由国家层面制定时，大国往往因"布鲁塞尔效应"与全球利益趋同，即平台对一国政策的反应会产生全球溢出效应。这种趋同降低了贸易协定中隐私规则的必要性。相比之下，广告技术税会催生"以邻为壑"的激励，使其成为国际合作的明确案例。
title: e‐Globalization and trade agreements
title_zh: e-全球化与贸易协定

abstract: Standard macroeconomic data do not cleanly separate the systematic and non-systematic components of monetary policy. We show that incorporating unstructured text data into the structural estimation of a DSGE model can sharpen this distinction. We augment a standard state-space model with a non-core measurement block that links structural shocks to time series derived from FOMC transcripts, using a spike-and-slab prior to let the data select which series are informative. In a medium-scale New Keynesian model for the U.S., incorporating text improves predictive performance and materially alters structural inference: the new model estimates a lower response of the policy rate to inflation, higher price stickiness and lower price indexation, implying a flatter and less backward-looking price Phillips curve.
abstract_zh: 标准宏观经济数据无法清晰区分货币政策的系统性与非系统性成分。我们证明，将非结构化文本数据纳入DSGE模型的结构估计能够强化这一区分。我们通过一个非核心测量模块对标准状态空间模型进行扩展，该模块将结构性冲击与源自联邦公开市场委员会（FOMC）会议记录的时序数据相关联，并采用尖峰-板状先验让数据自行选择具有信息量的序列。在美国中等规模新凯恩斯模型中，引入文本数据不仅提升了预测表现，还显著改变了结构性推断：新模型估计的政策利率对通胀的响应更低，价格粘性更高且价格指数化程度更低，这意味着更平坦且更少后顾性的价格菲利普斯曲线。
title: Structural Estimation with Unstructured Data
title_zh: 基于非结构化数据的结构估计

abstract: Trade networks underpinning the energy transition are endogenous economic objects, and their structure is a source of market power. Using bilateral trade data for thirteen electrification metals over 1995–2023, we show that trade in these materials has reorganised into a hub-and-spoke system centred on China, in sharp contrast to the diffuse, multilateral structure of fossil fuels. This centrality did not follow from resource endowments: China holds few of the underlying reserves. It was built through processing investment, industrial policy, and commodity-targeted development finance—an equilibrium outcome rather than a geographical accident. We formalise this in a stylised model in which a country chooses how central to become, and show that centrality maps into pricing power: the world price response to a strategic supply cut is stronger when the network is more concentrated and downstream demand and fringe supply are more inelastic. Constructing text-based, commodity-specific supply shocks and estimating local projections, we find that supply contractions in critical metals raise US and EU consumer prices by roughly twice as much as comparable fossil-fuel shocks, and more persistently. Centrality is therefore not merely descriptive: it creates leverage over global prices. The green transition reduces strategic dependence on hydrocarbon exporters but reconstitutes it around mineral supply chains. That's 200 words. abstract_zh: 支撑能源转型的贸易网络是内生的经济对象，其结构构成市场势力的来源。利用1995-2023年间十三种电气化金属的双边贸易数据，我们发现这些材料的贸易已重组为以中国为中心的轴辐式体系，与化石燃料分散的多边结构形成鲜明对比。这种中心地位并非源于资源禀赋：中国持有的相关储量极少。它是通过加工投资、产业政策和针对特定商品的发展融资构建而成——这是均衡结果而非地理偶然。我们通过一个简约模型对此进行形式化，在该模型中，国家自主选择中心化程度，并证明中心化映射为定价权：当网络更集中、下游需求与边缘供给更缺乏弹性时，战略性供给削减对世界价格的冲击更强。通过构建基于文本的商品特定供给冲击并估计局部投影，我们发现关键金属的供给收缩使美欧消费者价格涨幅约为可比化石燃料冲击的两倍，且持续性更强。因此，中心化不仅是描述性特征：它创造了影响全球价格的杠杆。绿色转型减少了对碳氢化合物出口国的战略依赖，但将其重构于矿产供应链之上。

abstract: Subjective evaluations in many contexts can be influenced by decision-makers' social preferences. We investigate this phenomenon using data from soccer referees' decisions. Referees are expected to evaluate each episode independently, regardless of prior calls. However, if referees dislike creating inequities between teams, they might compensate for earlier decisions. For instance, after awarding a penalty to the home team, they may apply a higher threshold when awarding a second penalty to the same team while lowering the threshold for the away team. Using play-by-play data from 21,400 matches in major European leagues, we find that referees exhibit a strong preference for equality: they increase the probability of awarding a penalty or issuing a red or yellow card against a team if the opposing team was previously subject to a similar decision, and reduce that probability if the team itself was previously subject to one. Finally, focusing on injury time, we show that referees tend to extend it when either the home or the away team is behind, further suggesting that referees have a preference for treating both teams equally.
title: Inequity aversion in subjective evaluations: evidence from referees' decisions in soccer

abstract: We explore whether a civic integration exam component dedicated to labor market training, namely the ONA - a type of job search assistance program, boosts refugees’ economic outcomes and the quality of firms they work for. Using linked employer-employee (monthly) data from 2014 to 2021 for the Netherlands and Regression Discontinuity design, we find that taking the ONA sped up and deepened the economic integration of refugees for at least 3 years in terms of increased employment probability and higher hourly wages. We further show that taking the ONA results in refugees working for larger, less routine-task intensive, higher wage firms. These results reflect improvements in both match efficiency and match quality. The ONA therefore does more than reduce search frictions: it equips refugees with the knowledge to navigate the labor market effectively and find employment that aligns better with their existing abilities and human capital.
abstract_zh: 我们探讨了公民融合考试中专门针对劳动力市场培训的一个组成部分，即ONA——一种求职援助项目，是否能提升难民的经济成果及其所服务企业的质量。利用荷兰2014年至2021年关联雇主-雇员（月度）数据及断点回归设计，我们发现参加ONA加速并深化了难民的经济融合，至少在3年内表现为就业概率提高和小时工资上升。我们进一步表明，参加ONA导致难民在规模更大、常规任务密集度较低、工资更高的企业中工作。这些结果反映了匹配效率和匹配质量的提升。因此，ONA不仅仅减少了搜索摩擦：它赋予难民有效驾驭劳动力市场的知识，并找到与其现有能力和人力资本更契合的就业机会。
title: Refugees’ Economic Integration and Firms

abstract: Abstract Leveraging a major Italian reform enacted in July 2012 that eroded employment protection to workers on permanent contracts, we use detailed worker level administrative data to estimate how this reduction affected the cost of job loss. We employ a stacked event-study research design, comparing treated and untreated workers as they move from employment into nonemployment. Weakening employment protection led to additional penalties in terms of lower re-hiring earnings and lower re-employment probabilities. Heterogeneous effects of the reform deepened pre-existing divides, penalizing labor market outsiders, such as young workers, and curbing employment opportunities for individuals in poorer regions, such as the South.
abstract_zh: 摘要 利用意大利2012年7月实施的一项重大改革，该改革削弱了对永久合同工人的就业保护，我们采用详细的工人层面行政数据，估计这一削减如何影响失业成本。我们运用堆叠事件研究设计，比较受改革影响与未受影响的工人在从就业转向非就业过程中的差异。就业保护的弱化导致再就业收入降低和再就业概率下降的额外惩罚。改革的异质性效应加深了原有的分化，对劳动力市场边缘群体（如年轻工人）造成不利影响，并限制了较贫困地区（如南部）个体的就业机会。
title: Does Weaker Employment Protection Lower the Cost of Job Loss?
title_zh: 更弱的就业保护会降低失业成本吗？

abstract: This paper studies how increased immigration enforcement in the destination country impacts labor markets in the origin country. Using variation in Mexican migrant networks and Secure Communities (SC), a policy which expanded local immigration enforcement, I show that the deportation of Mexican migrants from the U.S. increases return migration to Mexico and decreases monthly earnings for workers there. The negative earnings effects are largest for workers most similar to return migrants in terms of their demographics, occupations, and employment types, and are consistent with increased labor market competition.
abstract_zh: 本文研究了目的地国家加强移民执法如何影响来源国的劳动力市场。利用墨西哥移民网络及“安全社区”（Secure Communities, SC）政策——该政策扩大了地方移民执法范围——的变异，我证明美国对墨西哥移民的驱逐增加了返回墨西哥的移民数量，并降低了当地工人的月收入。负面收入效应在那些与返回移民在人口特征、职业及就业类型上最为相似的工人中最为显著，这与劳动力市场竞争加剧的解释相一致。
title: Immigration Enforcement and Origin Country Labor Markets
title_zh: 移民执法与来源国劳动力市场

abstract: We analyze how social-planner insurers split cost-sharing between consumers and firms (e.g. patients and doctors, or drivers and car mechanics). With no contracting frictions, firm cost-sharing can replace consumer cost-sharing other than “visit copays.” Optimal firm contracts depend on the marginal rate of substitution between consumer and firm cost-sharing. For Medicare physician services, paying physicians more up front but less as spending increases reduces risk for both patients and providers; in our calibration, net benefits are twice those from eliminating Medigap externality. For prescription drugs, a dollar of physician paperwork costs is 45–110 times more impactful than a dollar of consumer cost-sharing.
abstract_zh: 我们分析了社会规划型保险公司如何在消费者与企业（例如患者与医生，或驾驶员与汽车修理工）之间分摊成本。在不存在契约摩擦的情况下，除"就诊共付额"外，企业成本分摊可替代消费者成本分摊。最优企业契约取决于消费者与企业成本分摊之间的边际替代率。以医疗保险医师服务为例，提高预付比例但降低随支出递增的支付比例，可同时降低患者与医疗服务提供者的风险；在我们的校准模型中，其净收益是消除医疗补充保险外部性收益的两倍。对于处方药而言，一美元医师文书成本的影响效力是消费者成本分摊的45至110倍。
title: Insurance with Multiple Actors

abstract: Many effects of pollution exposure on health and education outcomes of children have been identified, but little is known about education effects on preschool-aged children. We estimate the effect of particulate matter air pollution on preschool attendance using restricted administrative data from the state of Georgia. We use thermal inversions, weather phenomena that trap pollutants, as an instrumental variable for pollution. A one-unit increase in the county-week average ambient particulate pollution level decreases attendance by around 2 percentage points. Effects seem to be larger for racial minorities and for children with working parents.
abstract_zh: 已有研究证实污染暴露对儿童健康与教育成果的多重影响，但关于学龄前儿童教育影响的研究仍较为有限。本研究利用佐治亚州的受限行政数据，评估颗粒物空气污染对学前教育出勤率的影响。我们采用热逆温现象（一种滞留污染物的天气现象）作为污染的工具变量。数据显示，县级周均环境颗粒物污染水平每上升1个单位，学前教育出勤率将下降约2个百分点。该影响在少数族裔儿童及父母双职工家庭中更为显著。

abstract: We study the interplay between informality, health, and education in South Africa. Using data from the National Income Dynamics Study, we document large disparities in health and labor market outcomes over the life cycle. We develop and estimate a life-cycle search-and-matching model with endogenous education and a dual labor market. We show that informal employment and poor health reinforce each other, generating a persistent poverty and poor-health trap. Policy experiments show that the optimal reform combines tertiary education subsidies, a broader tax base, and a lower average tax burden on earnings, increasing employment, welfare, and health while preserving fiscal balance.
abstract_zh: 本文研究南非非正规经济、健康与教育之间的相互作用。基于国家收入动态研究数据，我们记录了生命周期中健康与劳动力市场结果的显著差异。我们构建并估计了一个包含内生教育决策与二元劳动力市场的生命周期搜寻匹配模型。研究表明，非正规就业与不良健康状况相互强化，形成持续性的贫困与健康恶化陷阱。政策实验显示，最优改革方案需结合高等教育补贴、扩大税基与降低平均劳动所得税负，在维持财政平衡的同时提升就业率、社会福利与健康水平。
title: Breaking the Poverty and Poor-Health Trap: A Structural Analysis of Informality in South Africa

abstract: Weather shocks increasingly threaten agricultural productivity in Sub-Saharan Africa. While the negative effects of drought on production have been documented in numerous studies, the behavioral dimension of adaptation, particularly how households perceive drought and what shapes these perceptions, remains less explored. The study focuses on Uganda to distinguish between self-reported drought (subjective) and data-driven drought (objective) and how their divergence is associated with agricultural outcomes. The study relies on four waves of household surveys (UNPS for 2009/10, 2010/11, 2011/12, and 2013/14) with historical re-analysis data on temperature and precipitation from 1981 to 2015. Log-linear and logit models are applied to estimate the association between drought, perception, and household characteristics on production and drought perception formation. Objective drought is negatively associated with total value of production. Subjective drought perception has a positive association with production. Self-reported drought captures differences in households’ behavioral responses or preparedness, rather than observed weather shocks. Households that underestimate drought conditions tend to exhibit lower production outcomes, while households reporting a drought when this is not observed in objective data tend to maintain their production levels. Access to the Drought Early Warning System (DEWS), technology adoption, higher education levels, farming experience, and greater off-farm assets are positively associated with higher production. Conversely, lower production is associated with a higher share of female labor, female-headed households, and poverty. The results highlight the importance of distinguishing between perceived and observed drought and improving households’ access to timely information to plan adaptation strategies.
abstract_zh: 天气冲击日益威胁撒哈拉以南非洲的农业生产。尽管大量研究已证实干旱对生产的负面影响，但适应行为维度——尤其是家庭如何感知干旱以及影响这些感知的因素——仍鲜有探讨。本研究聚焦乌干达，区分自我报告的干旱（主观）与数据驱动的干旱（客观），并分析两者差异与农业产出的关联。研究采用四轮家庭调查数据（乌干达国家面板调查2009/10、2010/11、2011/12和2013/14年度）及1981至2015年历史再分析气温与降水数据，运用对数线性模型和逻辑模型估计干旱、感知及家庭特征对生产和干旱感知形成的影响。客观干旱与生产总价值呈负相关，而主观干旱感知与生产呈正相关。自我报告的干旱反映的是家庭行为响应或准备程度的差异，而非实际观测到的天气冲击。低估干旱条件的家庭往往产出较低，而在客观数据未显示干旱时报告干旱的家庭则能维持生产水平。获取干旱早期预警系统、采用技术、较高教育水平、务农经验及更多非农资产与更高产出正相关；反之，女性劳动力占比高、女性户主家庭及贫困则与较低产出相关。研究结果凸显区分感知干旱与观测干旱的重要性，并强调需改善家庭获取及时信息的渠道以规划适应策略。
title: Distinguishing drought experiences: From perception to measurement and their significance on productivity value in Uganda

abstract: Education and corruption are negatively correlated at the cross-national level, but little is known about the causal relationship between the two. We combine newly-collected data on timing and locations of Vietnam's national expansion of universities with detailed survey data on experiences of corruption from over 170,000 respondents in 320 districts across 12 years. Using staggered difference-in-differences, we show that cohorts exposed to the university expansion are 78% more likely to have a university education. However, this increase neither translates into fewer individuals being affected by corruption nor increases the propensity to denounce corrupt officials. Instead, we find that education increases exposure to corruption at the individual level. The mechanism for this increase that is most consistent with our data is that education raises household income and higher income leads to more bribe payments.
abstract_zh: 教育与腐败在国家层面呈负相关，但两者间的因果关系尚不明确。本研究将越南全国大学扩张的时间与地点新数据，与涵盖12年间320个地区逾17万受访者腐败经历详情的调查数据相结合。采用交错双重差分法分析发现，受大学扩张影响的群体接受高等教育的概率提升78%。然而，这一增长既未转化为受腐败影响人数的减少，也未提高举报腐败官员的倾向。相反，我们发现教育在个体层面增加了腐败暴露风险。与数据最吻合的机制解释是：教育提高了家庭收入，而更高收入导致更多贿赂支出。
title: The Effects of Education on Corruption: Evidence from Vietnam's University Expansion

abstract: Credit constraints often hinder investment in unincorporated enterprises, limiting innovation and overall performance, including reduced productivity and output, and slower growth. In this paper, we assess credit constraints on unincorporated enterprises using NSSO’s unit-level data from the Annual Survey of Unincorporated Enterprises 2022-23. Identifying the factors and determinants of credit constraints is crucial for informing policy recommendations. Based on sources of outstanding loans and survey responses, we classify enterprises into three categories: fully constrained, partially constrained, and not constrained. We find that manufacturing enterprises face more credit constraints than those engaged in trading and services. Furthermore, the study indicates that female entrepreneurs and those belonging to SC/ST or OBC castes face comparatively greater credit constraints than others. Other factors, such as region (rural vs. urban), size (annual turnover and asset value), GST registration status, price-cost margin, etc., are strong determinants of credit constraints or access to credit.
abstract_zh: 信贷约束常常阻碍非公司制企业的投资，限制其创新和整体绩效，导致生产率与产出下降、增长放缓。本文利用印度国家抽样调查局（NSSO）2022-23年度非公司制企业调查的单位级数据，评估了非公司制企业面临的信贷约束。识别信贷约束的影响因素及决定机制，对于制定政策建议至关重要。基于未偿贷款来源和调查反馈，我们将企业分为三类：完全受约束、部分受约束和不受约束。研究发现，制造业企业比贸易和服务业企业面临更严重的信贷约束。此外，女性企业家以及表列种姓/表列部落（SC/ST）或其他落后阶级（OBC）群体面临相对更大的信贷约束。其他因素如地区（农村与城市）、规模（年营业额和资产价值）、商品与服务税（GST）注册状态、价格-成本利润率等，均是信贷约束或信贷获取能力的强决定因素。

abstract: There has been a dramatic rise in disability employment since the pandemic. At the same time, work from home (WFH) has risen four-fold. This paper asks whether the two are causally related. Controlling for compositional changes and labor market tightness, a 1 percentage point increase in WFH increases full-time employment by 1.0% for individuals with a physical disability. The postpandemic increase in working from home explains 68%-85% of the rise in full-time employment. Wage data suggests that WFH increased the supply of workers with a physical disability, likely by reducing commuting costs and enabling better control of working conditions.
abstract_zh: 自疫情以来，残障人士就业率显著上升。与此同时，居家办公比例增长了四倍。本文探究两者是否存在因果关系。在控制人口结构变化与劳动力市场紧张程度后，居家办公比例每上升1个百分点，身体残障人士的全职就业率将提高1.0%。疫情后居家办公的普及可解释全职就业率增长的68%-85%。工资数据显示，居家办公通过降低通勤成本并改善工作条件自主性，有效扩大了身体残障人士的劳动力供给。

abstract: Antiretroviral therapy (ART) for HIV/AIDS has expanded rapidly across low-income countries since 2000, generating large gains in life expectancy. Exploiting spatial and temporal variation in ART availability, this paper examines the health and economic consequences of ART introduction across a comprehensive set of outcomes in rural Malawi, a low-income setting with high HIV prevalence. We find that ART substantially reduces prime-age mortality. Although these health gains raise individual prime-age labor supply, total household labor supply and household earnings are unchanged. We show that this divergence reflects the outward migration of prime-age household members, particularly men. Consistent with this mechanism, households receive sizable increases in remittances. Our findings identify migration as an important, but previously overlooked channel through which health shapes household economic outcomes.
abstract_zh: 自2000年以来，低收入国家针对HIV/AIDS的抗逆转录病毒疗法（ART）迅速普及，显著提升了预期寿命。本文利用马拉维农村地区（一个HIV感染率高、收入水平低的地区）ART可及性的时空差异，系统考察了该疗法引入对一系列健康与经济结果的影响。研究发现，ART显著降低了壮年人口死亡率。尽管这一健康改善提高了个人壮年劳动力供给，但家庭总劳动力供给与家庭收入并未发生变化。研究表明，这种分化源于壮年家庭成员（尤其是男性）的外迁。与这一机制相符的是，家庭收到的汇款显著增加。我们的发现揭示了迁移作为健康影响家庭经济结果的重要渠道，而这一渠道此前未被充分关注。

abstract: This paper investigates how marginal utility varies with health status (e.g. health-state dependence) while allowing this relationship to differ across income levels. Building on the existing literature, we develop a framework that quantifies the income adjustments necessary to maintain individuals’ wellbeing when they become disabled. Using SHARE data, we empirically estimate how health affects the marginal utility of consumption across the income distribution for older adults in Europe. Our results show that health-state dependence is negative among low-income individuals, indicating that their marginal utility of consumption declines when their health worsens. In contrast, at the very top of the income distribution, health-state dependence is positive, implying that marginal utility of consumption rises as health deteriorates.
abstract_zh: 本文研究了边际效用如何随健康状况变化（即健康状态依赖性），并允许这种关系在不同收入水平上存在差异。在现有文献基础上，我们构建了一个框架，用以量化个体在残疾时维持其福祉所需的收入调整。利用SHARE数据，我们实证估计了健康如何影响欧洲老年人消费边际效用的收入分布差异。研究结果表明，低收入群体的健康状态依赖性为负，即其健康状况恶化时消费边际效用下降。相反，在收入分布顶端，健康状态依赖性为正，意味着健康状况恶化时消费边际效用上升。

abstract: We study the formation of risk perceptions— subjective probability beliefs— of three adverse events—COVID-19 contagion, influenza contagion, and food poisoning—at the onset and outset of the COVID-19 pandemic in the United States, using survey data. We show that perceived risk levels for COVID-19 are similar to those for influenza but are not significantly influenced by proximity to infection and are shaped instead by an individual's gender, education, and employment status. Using an instrumental variable strategy, we assess whether these perceptions influence a number of protective behaviors. Although risk perceptions are associated with various protective behaviors, we only find a causal impact in increasing the likelihood of phone or online medical consultations by only about a percentage point
abstract_zh: 我们利用调查数据，研究了美国新冠疫情初期与暴发阶段，民众对三种不良事件——新冠病毒感染、流感感染及食物中毒——的风险感知（即主观概率信念）的形成机制。研究表明，民众对新冠病毒的风险感知水平与流感相似，但并未显著受到感染邻近性的影响，而是由个体的性别、教育程度及就业状况所塑造。通过工具变量策略，我们评估了这些风险感知是否影响多种防护行为。尽管风险感知与各类防护行为存在关联，但我们仅发现其对增加电话或在线医疗咨询概率具有因果效应，且该效应仅约一个百分点。
title: Risk Perceptions and Protective Behaviors at the Onset and Outset of the COVID-19 Pandemic

abstract: This paper studies the role of private supplemental health insurance (SHI) in universal healthcare systems. Linking novel microdata on SHI contracts to rich administrative data from Sweden, we document a steep income gradient in take-up: higher-income individuals are substantially more likely to enroll in SHI despite a greater healthcare need among lower-income individuals. Exploiting variation in the timing of employer-sponsored SHI, we find large and persistent increases in healthcare utilization (23 percent). The effects are even larger for low-income individuals and extend beyond specialist consultations to high-value treatments, consistent with binding rationing in public care. Focusing on cancer as a high-stakes condition, we find that SHI increases screening and diagnoses and reduces mortality. Although SHI is privately contracted, its effects materialize largely within the public healthcare system: coverage increases publicly financed utilization and reduces waiting times, generating negative fiscal and congestion externalities.
abstract_zh: 本文研究私人补充医疗保险（SHI）在全民医疗体系中的作用。通过将瑞典新型SHI合同微观数据与丰富的行政数据相关联，我们发现参保率存在显著的收入梯度：尽管低收入群体医疗需求更大，但高收入个体参保SHI的可能性显著更高。利用雇主提供SHI的时间差异，我们发现医疗利用率出现大幅且持续的增长（23%）。这种效应在低收入群体中更为显著，且影响范围从专科门诊延伸至高价值治疗，这与公共医疗中的刚性配给机制一致。以癌症这一高风险疾病为例，我们发现SHI提高了筛查率和诊断率，并降低了死亡率。尽管SHI属于私人合同，但其效应主要显现在公共医疗体系内：参保增加了公共医疗资源的使用并缩短了等待时间，从而产生负面的财政和拥堵外部性。
title: The Impact and Incidence of Supplemental Health Insurance: Evidence from Sweden
title_zh: 补充健康保险的影响与发生率：来自瑞典的证据

abstract: We estimate the long-term mental health impact of an alcohol policy experiment on individuals exposed to the policy in utero. The policy lasted for 8.5 months and significantly expanded access to alcohol, especially for those under age 21. Armed with administrative data on healthcare visits, drug prescriptions, and psychological assessments and applying a triple-differences strategy, we show that prenatal policy exposure had a substantial, early, and persistent impact on the mental health of the children of young mothers. The exposed cohorts conceived just before the policy started are 16% more likely to be diagnosed with a mental condition in midlife. We find effects on common midlife conditions such as depression and anxiety, on the ability to cope with psychologically stressful situations at age 18, and on neurodevelopmental disorders that manifest in early childhood. Among individuals with predicted mental health care needs, the impact of the policy on midlife earnings is significantly lower when they reside in areas with lower barriers to accessing mental health care, with a one-standard-deviation increase in local treatment intensity reducing the negative earnings effect by about one-third. Our findings indicate that policies increasing access to mental health treatments could substantially improve labor market outcomes, even for conditions with early-life origins.
abstract_zh: 我们估算了某项酒精政策实验对子宫内暴露个体的长期心理健康影响。该政策持续了8.5个月，显著扩大了酒精获取渠道，尤其对21岁以下人群影响显著。利用医疗就诊、处方药及心理评估的行政数据，并采用三重差分策略，我们发现产前政策暴露对年轻母亲子女的心理健康产生了显著、早期且持续的影响。在政策启动前受孕的暴露队列，中年时期被诊断出心理疾病的概率高出16%。我们观察到该政策对常见中年疾病（如抑郁和焦虑）、18岁时应对心理压力情境的能力，以及儿童早期显现的神经发育障碍均存在影响。在预测有心理健康护理需求的个体中，当居住地获取心理护理的障碍较低时，政策对中年收入的负面影响显著减弱——当地治疗强度每增加一个标准差，收入负面效应约减少三分之一。研究结果表明，即便对于具有早期起源的心理疾病，增加心理治疗可及性的政策也能显著改善劳动力市场表现。
title: Prenatal Conditions and Midlife Mental Health: Evidence from an Alcohol Policy Experiment
title_zh: 产前条件与中年心理健康：来自一项酒精政策实验的证据

abstract: Large cities worldwide have adopted congestion pricing to reduce urban traffic, with well-documented benefits for travel speeds, accident rates, and air quality. This paper identifies a novel external benefit: faster emergency medical service (EMS) response times. We provide the first evidence on how the congestion pricing program in New York City – the first comprehensive cordon-based congestion pricing system in the U.S. that was implemented on January 5th, 2025 – affects EMS performance. Exploiting the sharp geographic boundary of New York City’s congestion relief zone at 60th Street and a difference-in-discontinuities design, we first document substantial changes in traffic and mobility near the boundary: vehicular traffic declines by roughly 18 to 21 percent, accompanied by increases in pedestrian and bicycle activity. Consistent with these first-stage mechanisms, we find that congestion pricing improves EMS performance, reducing total travel times by 63–70 seconds (approximately 5–6 percent). Effects emerged quickly and show little evidence of displacement to adjacent areas. A concurrent FDNY directive requiring transport to the nearest hospital confounds standard difference-in-differences estimates but not our boundary-based design. These findings suggest that cost-benefit analyses of congestion pricing systematically understate net social benefits by omitting emergency response improvements.
abstract_zh: 全球各大城市已普遍采用拥堵收费政策以减少城市交通拥堵，其在提升通行速度、降低事故率及改善空气质量方面的效益已有充分文献佐证。本文识别出一项新型外部效益：急救医疗服务响应时间的缩短。我们首次提供了关于纽约市拥堵收费计划——美国首个于2025年1月5日实施的综合性区域拥堵收费系统——如何影响急救医疗服务绩效的证据。利用纽约市拥堵缓解区在第60街的清晰地理边界及断点回归设计，我们首先记录了边界附近交通与出行模式的显著变化：机动车流量下降约18%至21%，同时伴随步行与自行车活动的增加。与这些第一阶段机制相一致，我们发现拥堵收费改善了急救医疗服务绩效，将总行程时间缩短63至70秒（约5%至6%）。该效应迅速显现，且几乎没有证据表明其向邻近区域转移。纽约市消防局同时实施的将患者送往最近医院的指令混淆了传统双重差分估计结果，但未影响基于边界的识别设计。这些发现表明，拥堵收费的成本效益分析因忽略应急响应改善而系统性低估了净社会效益。

title: Congestion Pricing and Emergency Medical Service Response: Evidence from New York City
title_zh: 拥堵收费与紧急医疗服务响应：来自纽约市的证据

abstract: We develop a life cycle model that features food consumption, exercise, and deviation from reference BMI, which represents local social norms, to rationalize spatial concentration and the educational gradient in body mass in the US. BMI is determined by caloric balance and affects health and medical spending, the probability of survival, and the level of utility. We find that occupational strenuousness, food prices, medical expenditures, and labor income explain only a modest share of BMI differences across regions and education groups. Preference differences matter, but they account for the patterns only when amplified by social norms. To demonstrate the policy relevance of the social norm, we introduce a GLP-1 treatment policy targeting individuals with the highest food preferences. We find substantial direct effects on average BMI, with reductions of up to more than 6 pounds. Importantly, we document meaningful spillover effects arising from endogenous adjustment of reference BMI that further amplify these effects. The BMI reductions translate into substantial life expectancy gains for both treated individuals and untreated individuals through spillover effects.
abstract_zh: 我们构建了一个涵盖食物消费、运动以及偏离参考BMI（代表当地社会规范）的生命周期模型，以解释美国体重指数的空间集中现象及教育梯度。BMI由热量平衡决定，并影响健康与医疗支出、生存概率及效用水平。研究发现，职业体力消耗强度、食品价格、医疗支出和劳动收入仅能解释不同地区及教育群体间BMI差异的较小部分。偏好差异虽具影响，但仅在社会规范放大作用下才能解释现有模式。为论证社会规范的政策相关性，我们针对食物偏好最高群体引入GLP-1治疗政策。结果显示，该政策对平均BMI产生显著直接效应，降幅最高超过6磅。更重要的是，我们发现了由参考BMI内生调整引发的显著溢出效应，进一步放大了这些影响。通过溢出效应，BMI的降低为治疗组与未治疗组均带来实质性的预期寿命增益。
title: Together We Tip the Scale: Social Norms and Body Mass
title_zh: 共同影响体重：社会规范与身体质量指数

abstract: To increase farmer adoption of green practices, the EU Common Agricultural Policy includes both mandatory (conditionality) and voluntary instruments (eco‐schemes–ECS– and more demanding, multi‐annual agri‐environment‐climate measures –AECM–). Building on the experiment of Barreiro‐Hurle et al. (2023), which focused on eco‐schemes, this paper analyses farmers' stated willingness to voluntarily adopt AECM. Using a framed experiment with 600 farmers in Spain, Germany, and Poland, we compared two policy interventions—higher mandatory environmental requirements and an equivalent reduction in income linked to CAP direct payments—and varied their intensity. Higher mandatory environmental requirements and an equivalent income reduction reduce the willingness to voluntarily adopt AECM. We also find a positive conditional association between the intensity of ECS adoption and the willingness to adopt AECM, suggesting potential spillover effects. We further show that behavioral factors, particularly perceived fairness of compensation, environmental concern, confidence in the environmental program, and CAP entitlement, explain substantially more variation in willingness to adopt AECM than standard structural and socio‐demographic characteristics (farm and farmer features). These results have implications for the upcoming envisaged CAP green architecture.
abstract_zh: 摘要 为提升农民对绿色实践的采纳率，欧盟共同农业政策同时包含强制性（条件性）与自愿性工具（生态计划——ECS——以及要求更高、多年期的农业环境气候措施——AECM）。本文基于Barreiro‐Hurle等人（2023）聚焦生态计划的实验研究，进一步分析农民自愿采纳AECM的陈述意愿。通过对西班牙、德国和波兰600名农民开展框架实验，我们比较了两种政策干预——提高强制性环境要求与等额削减CAP直接支付相关的收入——并调整其强度。结果表明，更高的强制性环境要求与等额收入削减均会降低农民自愿采纳AECM的意愿。同时，我们发现ECS采纳强度与AECM采纳意愿之间存在正向条件关联，暗示潜在溢出效应。进一步分析显示，行为因素（尤其是补偿公平感知、环境关切、对环保项目的信心及CAP权益认知）对AECM采纳意愿的解释力显著高于标准的结构性与社会人口特征（农场与农民属性）。这些发现对即将实施的CAP绿色架构具有政策启示。
title:
What Really Drives Agri‐Environment‐Climate Measures' Adoption? Mandatory Requirements, Behavioral Traits, and Structural Factors in the
                    CAP
                    Green Architecture

abstract: This paper examines the short‐ and long‐run effects of the 2015 Nepal Earthquake on paddy production using a difference‐in‐differences framework and district‐level panel data spanning 2010–2019. We document a 10.95% decline in paddy production and a 6.94% decline in yield in earthquake‐affected districts in the short run, with effects fully dissipating over the long run. Decomposing production losses into intensive and extensive margins reveals that the intensive margin explains the majority of losses. Heterogeneity analysis shows that production losses scale with seismic intensity while yield losses operate as a common behavioural shock uniformly across affected districts. Household survey evidence confirms two reinforcing channels: a contraction in agricultural labour supply during the critical planting season and a reallocation of household resources toward reconstruction of damaged dwellings.
abstract_zh: 本文采用双重差分框架及2010–2019年区级面板数据，考察2015年尼泊尔地震对水稻生产的短期与长期影响。研究发现，地震受灾地区的水稻产量在短期内下降10.95%，单产下降6.94%，但长期来看这些影响完全消散。将产量损失分解为集约边际与广延边际后发现，集约边际解释了大部分损失。异质性分析表明，产量损失随地震烈度递增，而单产损失则表现为受灾地区普遍存在的共同行为冲击。家户调查证据证实了两种相互强化的传导渠道：关键播种季节农业劳动力供给的收缩，以及家户资源向受损房屋重建的重新配置。
journal: Australian Journal of Agricultural and Resource Economics
title: Agriculture and Natural Disasters: Evidence From the 2015 Nepal Earthquake
title_zh: 农业与自然灾害：来自2015年尼泊尔地震的证据

abstract: The rational behavior of a coalition requires the informational precondition that its members take into account the behavior and beliefs of others. In noncooperative games, we define Bayesian coalitional rationality as a mode of collective behavior that no coalition of players wishes to change, in the sense that there is no coalition-wise common belief that mutual gains can be achieved through a tacit coalitional agreement. We establish a fundamental possibility result: the assumption of Bayesian coalitional rationality and common belief of Bayesian coalitional rationality is attainable in a finite model. Under a belief-richness condition, this assumption characterizes the solution concept of Bayesian coalitional rationalizability. Our approach also provides a novel notion of individual rationality in game situations where players may be uncertain about their own types and strategy choices.
abstract_zh: 联盟的理性行为要求一个信息前提，即其成员需考虑他人的行为与信念。在非合作博弈中，我们将贝叶斯联盟理性定义为一种集体行为模式，即任何玩家联盟都不希望改变现状，其含义在于不存在联盟层面的共同信念，认为通过默契的联盟协议可以实现相互增益。我们确立了一个基本可能性结果：贝叶斯联盟理性及对其的共同信念假设在有限模型中是可实现的。在信念丰富性条件下，这一假设刻画了贝叶斯联盟理性化的解概念。我们的方法还为玩家可能对自身类型和策略选择不确定的博弈情境提供了一种新颖的个体理性概念。
publisher: Springer Science and Business Media LLC
title: Bayesian Coalitional Rationality in Games: An Informational Foundation
title_zh: 博弈中的贝叶斯联盟理性：一个信息基础

abstract: This paper studies how large firms’ synchronized lumpy investments endogenously shape an economy’s fragility to negative TFP shocks. I develop a heterogeneous-firm real business cycle model that matches the empirical interest rate elasticities of investment for both large and small firms. In the model, large firms’ lumpy investments become persistently synchronized due to their low sensitivity to general equilibrium effects, generating investment surges. Following these surges, TFP-induced recessions are particularly severe, and the semi-elasticity of aggregate investment drops significantly, consistent with the data.
abstract_zh: 摘要 本文研究大型企业同步化的大额投资如何内生地塑造经济对负向全要素生产率冲击的脆弱性。我构建了一个异质性企业真实商业周期模型，该模型能够匹配大型企业与小型企业投资对利率的实证弹性。在模型中，大型企业的大额投资因对一般均衡效应敏感度较低而持续同步化，从而引发投资激增。这些激增之后，全要素生产率冲击引发的衰退尤为严重，且总体投资的半弹性显著下降，这与数据表现一致。
journal: Journal of the European Economic Association
title: Striking While the Iron Is Cold: Fragility after a Surge of Lumpy Investments,
title_zh: 趁热打铁：大宗投资激增后的脆弱性

abstract: Political polarization is a growing concern in many countries. Are mass protests merely a sign of increasing cleavages, or do they polarize societies? In this paper, we estimate the impact of Nazi marches in 1932 Hamburg, using granular data from 622 voting precincts during 6 elections. We show propaganda can persuade – but it does by raising the share of areas with high levels of Nazi support. Importantly, marches can also backfire, repelling voters. Thus, protest marches lead to polarization. These effects diffused through social networks, measured as contagion patterns across neighborhoods from the 1918 Spanish flu outbreak. The electoral effects of social spillovers are of similar importance as direct exposure, and grow over time.
abstract_zh: 摘要 政治极化已成为多国日益严峻的挑战。大规模抗议究竟是社会裂痕加剧的表征，还是导致社会极化的动因？本文利用1932年汉堡622个投票区在六次选举中的微观数据，评估纳粹游行的影响。研究表明，宣传具有说服力——但其作用机制在于提升纳粹支持率较高区域的占比。关键在于，游行也可能产生反效果，即疏远选民。因此，抗议游行最终导致社会极化。这些效应通过社会网络扩散，其传播模式可通过1918年西班牙流感期间跨社区传染路径进行测度。社会溢出效应带来的选举影响与直接接触效应同等重要，且随时间推移持续增强。
journal: Journal of the European Economic Association
title: Going Viral: Protests and Polarization in 1932 Hamburg,
title_zh: 病毒式传播：1932年汉堡的抗议与极化

abstract: We show that a one-sided price-adjustment rule, with free price cuts but a fixed daily reset for price increases, raises the reset price even under risk neutrality, mean-zero wholesale cost shocks, and perfect consumer information. The mechanism is option-theoretic: a higher reset price preserves pass-through in adverse cost states, while favorable shocks can still be accommodated by price cuts. In differentiated Bertrand competition, the reset premium scales with cost pass-through and hence with substitutability. The mechanism is distinct from consumer search and strategic price dispersion because it operates even under perfect consumer price information.
abstract_zh: 我们证明，在风险中性、零均值批发成本冲击及消费者完全信息的条件下，单边价格调整规则——即允许自由降价但设定每日固定重置以应对涨价——仍会提高重置价格。其机制具有期权理论特征：较高的重置价格在不利成本状态下保持传导效应，而有利冲击则可通过降价来适应。在差异化伯特兰竞争中，重置溢价随成本传导程度及替代性增强而扩大。该机制不同于消费者搜索和策略性价格离散，因为它即使在消费者完全知晓价格信息的情况下也发挥作用。
title: The reset premium: Option value under asymmetric price commitment
title_zh: 重置溢价：非对称价格承诺下的期权价值

abstract: By 2025, over 42 million refugees will be hosted in low- and middle-income countries, which rely on one of two models: a humanitarian model centered on international aid and camp-based restrictions on integration, or a development-based model promoting self-reliance and gradual integration. We study the local development impacts of a pure humanitarian model, focusing on Rohingya refugees in Cox’s Bazar, Bangladesh. Combining remote sensing data with longitudinal household surveys, we exploit variation in distance to refugee camps before and after the refugee influx to explore the effects of this refugee hosting model. We find that areas closer to camps experienced higher economic growth following the arrival of the Rohingya. Household-level evidence points to humanitarian aid as the key mechanism: host communities near camps exhibit higher job formality, aid access, and food consumption. However, proximity to camps is also associated with adverse effects, including increased safety concerns and a higher prevalence of communicable diseases among host populations. These results are consistent with epidemiological spillovers and increased pressure on local infrastructure offsetting gains from expanded service provision.
abstract_zh: 到2025年，超过4200万难民将被安置在中低收入国家，这些国家依赖两种模式之一：一种是以国际援助和基于难民营的融合限制为中心的人道主义模式，另一种是促进自力更生和逐步融合的发展型模式。我们研究纯粹人道主义模式对当地发展的影响，重点关注孟加拉国科克斯巴扎尔的罗兴亚难民。结合遥感数据和纵向家庭调查，我们利用难民涌入前后距难民营距离的变化来探讨这种难民收容模式的影响。我们发现，在罗兴亚人抵达后，靠近难民营的地区经历了更高的经济增长。家庭层面的证据表明，人道主义援助是关键机制：靠近难民营的收容社区表现出更高的就业正规性、援助获取和食品消费。然而，靠近难民营也伴随着不利影响，包括收容人口中安全担忧增加和传染病患病率上升。这些结果与流行病学溢出效应以及当地基础设施压力增大抵消了服务扩展带来的收益相一致。
title: Refugees, camps, and host communities: Evidence from Bangladesh’s humanitarian hosting system
title_zh: 难民、难民营与收容社区：来自孟加拉国人道主义收容系统的证据

abstract: Traditionally, fund managers cast votes on behalf of fund investors. Recently, there is a shift toward “pass-through voting,” with funds offering investors a choice: delegate votes to the fund or vote themselves. We develop a framework to study the implications of voting choice. While it helps reflect heterogeneous investor preferences, it also shapes the informational content of the vote, and these forces can conflict. When interests are aligned, voting choice improves information aggregation and investor welfare. With preference heterogeneity or costly information, however, it can make investors worse off by weakening informed. (JEL D72, D82, D83, G34, K22)
abstract_zh: 摘要 传统上，基金经理代表基金投资者行使投票权。近期出现向“穿透式投票”的转变，基金为投资者提供选择：将投票权委托给基金或自行投票。我们构建了一个分析框架研究投票选择的影响。虽然投票选择有助于反映异质性投资者偏好，但也会塑造投票的信息含量，这两种力量可能相互冲突。当利益一致时，投票选择能改善信息聚合与投资者福利。然而，在偏好异质性或信息成本存在的情况下，投票选择可能因削弱知情投票而降低投资者福利。（JEL D72, D82, D83, G34, K22）
title: Voting Choice
title_zh: 投票选择

abstract: Many high-stakes organisational decisions are made by committees, where members exert costly influence to shape a single collective outcome. When committees are gender-imbalanced, the salience of gender identity may affect who mobilises influence and how numerical power translates into effective decision weight. We study how gender-identity salience interacts with numerical power in a controlled laboratory setting using a group-contest design. We vary the numerical balance of power (Female-Majority vs. Male-Majority) and manipulate whether gender composition is revealed. We find larger, advantaged groups invest significantly more and identity salience has asymmetric effects by gender. Among minority men facing female-majority groups, making gender salient increases investment and their initial disadvantage shrinks over time. Among minority women facing male-majority groups, investment does not increase and their relative disadvantage grows over time. These divergent responses are not explained by general social preferences or in-group cohesion. The findings suggest highlighting gender identity may intensify mobilisation by minority men without similarly empowering minority women, with implications for the design of diversity and transparency policies.
abstract_zh: 许多高风险的组织决策由委员会作出，其中成员投入高昂的影响力以塑造单一的集体结果。当委员会性别失衡时，性别身份的显著性可能影响谁动员影响力，以及数字上的权力如何转化为有效的决策权重。我们通过一个群体竞赛设计，在受控实验室环境中研究性别身份显著性与数字权力的相互作用。我们变化权力的数字平衡（女性占多数与男性占多数），并操纵性别构成是否被揭示。我们发现，规模较大且占优势的群体投资显著更多，且身份显著性对性别的影响具有不对称性。在面临女性占多数群体的少数男性中，使性别显著会增加投资，其初始劣势随时间缩小。在面临男性占多数群体的少数女性中，投资并未增加，其相对劣势随时间扩大。这些不同的反应无法由一般社会偏好或群体内聚力解释。研究结果表明，强调性别身份可能加剧少数男性的动员，而不会同样增强少数女性的力量，这对多样性和透明度政策的设计具有启示意义。
title: Gender identity and power imbalance in a group contest
title_zh: 群体竞赛中的性别认同与权力失衡

abstract: In this paper, we investigate whether, and to what extent, UK newspapers exhibited image-based bias in their portrayal of politicians during the 2016 Brexit referendum. We use computer vision and machine learning techniques to first, identify the faces of politicians and assess the emotional content conveyed through their expressions and second, to measure the contextual sentiment of the overall image, including elements such as background, objects, and color. Our findings reveal that tabloid newspapers displayed significant partisan bias. Specifically, pro-leave tabloids were more likely to depict pro-leave politicians with positive facial expressions and in more favorable visual contexts, while pro-remain politicians were portrayed more negatively. This bias was especially pronounced in front-page images and those featuring key political figures, while no comparable patterns were found in broadsheets. However, the visual bias diminished immediately after the referendum vote. Our scalable framework not only provides a systematic way to detect visual bias in political imagery but also underscores the growing need for media accountability and visual literacy as images play an increasingly powerful role in shaping political communication.
abstract_zh: 本文探究了2016年英国脱欧公投期间，英国报纸在描绘政治人物时是否存在以及多大程度上存在基于图像的偏见。我们运用计算机视觉与机器学习技术，首先识别政治人物的面部并评估其表情所传达的情感内容，其次衡量整体图像的语境情感，包括背景、物体和色彩等元素。研究结果显示，小报呈现出显著的党派偏见。具体而言，支持脱欧的小报更倾向于以积极的面部表情和更有利的视觉语境描绘支持脱欧的政治人物，而支持留欧的政治人物则被更负面地呈现。这种偏见在头版图像及关键政治人物特写中尤为突出，而大报中未发现类似模式。然而，视觉偏见在公投投票结束后立即减弱。我们提出的可扩展框架不仅为检测政治图像中的视觉偏见提供了系统性方法，也凸显了随着图像在塑造政治传播中日益增强的作用，媒体问责与视觉素养的需求正不断增长。
title: Visual bias in the Brexit referendum: A quantitative analysis of newspaper images
title_zh: 英国脱欧公投中的视觉偏见：报纸图像的定量分析

abstract: We compile a unique dataset linking micro price data underlying the official Swedish producer price index with administrative firm level data and provide new evidence on the inflationary effects of global supply chain shocks. For identification, we interact exogenous shocks to global supply chains, obtained through a VAR model, with firm-specific import shares. Shocks to global supply chains lead to a significant and persistent increase in producer prices with a peak response after two years. Importantly, average responses mask heterogeneous responses across firms. Relatively larger firms, firms with lower labor costs and a higher market share raise prices more strongly.
abstract_zh: 我们构建了一个独特的数据集，将瑞典官方生产者价格指数背后的微观价格数据与行政企业层面数据相结合，为全球供应链冲击的通胀效应提供了新证据。为进行识别，我们通过VAR模型获取的全球供应链外生冲击与企业特定的进口份额进行交互作用。全球供应链冲击导致生产者价格显著且持续上升，峰值反应出现在两年后。重要的是，平均反应掩盖了企业间的异质性反应。相对较大的企业、劳动成本较低且市场份额较高的企业，其价格上调幅度更大。
title: The inflationary effects of global supply chain shocks: Evidence from Swedish microdata
title_zh: 全球供应链冲击的通胀效应：来自瑞典微观数据的证据

abstract: We study how politically polarized television news shapes household inflation expectations in Turkey. We combine new household panel data with transcript-based measures of channel-level inflation coverage during prime-time news and a large-scale randomized information experiment. Inflation coverage differs sharply across politically aligned channels, and viewers sort into outlets consistent with their political affiliations. Within-person estimates show that greater coverage on a respondent’s initially preferred channel leads to higher inflation expectations, with effects concentrated among viewers of politically neutral channels. Experimental evidence indicates that belief updating depends on prior anchoring as well as on source credibility and reveals the political costs of rising inflation expectations.
abstract_zh: 本文研究政治极化电视新闻如何影响土耳其家庭通胀预期。我们结合新的家庭面板数据、基于文本分析的黄金时段新闻频道通胀报道指标，以及大规模随机信息实验。不同政治倾向频道的通胀报道存在显著差异，观众会根据自身政治立场选择观看渠道。个体内估计显示，受访者初始偏好频道对通胀的报道越多，其通胀预期越高，且该效应集中于观看政治中立频道的观众群体。实验证据表明，信念更新既取决于先验锚定效应，也受信息来源可信度影响，并揭示了通胀预期上升的政治成本。
title: Polarized Media and Inflation Expectations
title_zh: 极化媒体与通胀预期

abstract: We construct postwar U.S. patent time series by funding source and ownership. In local projections with rich macroeconomic controls, disciplined by external instruments and information-set tests, unanticipated filings serve as source-specific technology-shock proxies. Government-funded but privately owned patents are two percent of filings, yet explain about one-fifth of medium-run fluctuations in TFP and GDP. Responses propagate through private R&D and investment, with model-implied social returns to public R&D about twice those to private R&D. Effects concentrate in science-based patents supported by NIH and NSF or assigned to universities, research institutes, and start-ups. Government-owned patents have weak average effects but a consequential upper tail.
abstract_zh: 我们按资金来源和所有权构建了战后美国专利时间序列。在包含丰富宏观经济控制变量的局部投影中，通过外部工具变量和信息集检验的约束，未预期的专利申请被用作特定来源的技术冲击代理变量。政府资助但私人拥有的专利仅占专利申请量的2%，却解释了全要素生产率（TFP）和GDP中期波动的约五分之一。其影响通过私人研发和投资传导，模型隐含的公共研发社会回报率约为私人研发的两倍。效应集中于由美国国立卫生研究院（NIH）和国家科学基金会（NSF）支持、或分配给大学、研究机构和初创企业的科学型专利。政府拥有的专利平均效应较弱，但存在显著的上尾分布。
title: Where Do Technology Shocks Come From? Public Funding and Private Ownership
title_zh: 技术冲击从何而来？公共资助与私人所有权

abstract: We estimate the impact of catastrophic wildfires on suicide. Leveraging an eight-year panel of county-by-month restricted-use mortality data for California, we find that catastrophic wildfires that destroy at least 2% of a county’s housing stock cause a 47% increase in the suicide rate (roughly nine excess suicides) in the six-month aftermath of an event. Exploring sources of heterogeneity, effects are largely driven by men. Mechanisms are explored and suggest that suicide results from the loss of property and direct loss of life, rather than smoke exposure. These findings suggest that wildfires may be deadlier and more expensive than previously thought.
abstract_zh: 摘要 本文估算了灾难性野火对自杀率的影响。利用加州按县-月划分的八年限制使用死亡率面板数据，我们发现，摧毁一个县至少2%住房存量的灾难性野火，会在事件发生后的六个月内导致自杀率上升47%（约增加9例自杀）。在异质性来源的探索中，影响主要由男性群体驱动。机制分析表明，自杀源于财产损失和直接生命损失，而非烟雾暴露。这些发现表明，野火可能比此前认为的更具致命性和更高成本。
publisher: Springer Science and Business Media LLC
title: Catastrophic Wildfires & Suicide
title_zh: 灾难性野火与自杀

abstract: Urban flooding poses escalating risks under climate change, requiring planning approaches that integrate technological precision with human and ecological values. This study introduces a Human-Centred Artificial Intelligence (HCAI) framework for adaptive and regenerative flood-resilient urban design. Unlike conventional AI approaches focused on optimisation, HCAI embeds ethical, participatory, and context-sensitive principles into land-use governance. The paper develops a four-pillar analytical framework – technical integration, institutional arrangements, stakeholder engagement, and land-use innovation – operationalised through a document-based comparative analysis of nine cities representing diverse flood typologies, governance regimes, and documented AI/digital flood-resilience activity. Documentary evidence suggests that AI tools such as Machine Learning, Deep Learning, and Graph Neural Networks are reported to support flood-risk prediction and response coordination in flood-risk applications, while their planning relevance depends on inclusive decision-making and regenerative land-use strategies. Cities with stronger institutional embedding of AI-enabled or digital tools within adaptive regulatory systems and participatory platforms (e.g., Rotterdam, Copenhagen, Bangkok) show clearer planning-policy pathways, whereas those relying on fragmented or project-based deployments (e.g., Venice, Sydney) show limited continuity. Findings suggest that technical capability alone is insufficient: planning relevance depends on governance maturity, ethical safeguards, civic legitimacy, and linkage to spatial planning instruments. By coupling algorithmic intelligence with participatory and regulatory innovation, the study advances a policy-oriented framework for embedding HCAI into spatial governance and identifying conditions that may support a shift from defensive flood control toward regenerative, socially just urbanism. The framework guides AI institutionalisation within land-use systems and contributes to debates on equitable, data-driven climate adaptation.
abstract_zh: 气候变化背景下，城市洪涝风险持续加剧，亟需融合技术精度与人文生态价值的规划路径。本研究提出以人为中心的人工智能（HCAI）框架，用于适应性、再生性防洪韧性城市设计。与侧重优化的传统AI方法不同，HCAI将伦理、参与性和情境敏感性原则嵌入土地利用治理体系。本文构建了包含技术整合、制度安排、利益相关方参与和土地利用创新四大支柱的分析框架，通过对九个代表不同洪涝类型、治理体制及AI/数字防洪韧性实践案例的城市进行文献比较分析加以验证。文献证据表明，机器学习、深度学习、图神经网络等AI工具在洪涝风险应用中可支持风险预测与响应协调，但其规划相关性取决于包容性决策与再生性土地利用策略。在适应性监管体系与参与式平台中实现AI或数字工具制度化嵌入的城市（如鹿特丹、哥本哈根、曼谷），展现出更清晰的规划政策路径；而依赖碎片化或项目式部署的城市（如威尼斯、悉尼）则呈现有限连续性。研究结果表明，单纯技术能力不足：规划相关性取决于治理成熟度、伦理保障、公民合法性及与空间规划工具的衔接。通过将算法智能与参与式及监管创新相结合，本研究提出了将HCAI嵌入空间治理的政策导向框架，并识别出可能推动从防御性洪涝控制向再生性、社会公正城市主义转型的条件。该框架为土地利用系统中的AI制度化提供指引，并推动关于公平、数据驱动气候适应的学术讨论。
title: Revolutionizing flood resilience: Human-centred AI for adaptive and regenerative urban design
title_zh: 变革洪水韧性：面向适应性与再生性城市设计的以人为本人工智能

abstract: The “tragedy of the horizon” captures the gap between long-horizon climate damages and the shorter horizons of corporate decision-making. We provide a contracting account of this idea using a deliberately standard CARA-normal moral-hazard model. Under full commitment, the optimal linear contract can condition on long-horizon outcomes; horizon mismatch alone does not generate underinvestment. The tragedy arises when shareholders cannot credibly commit today to compensate a CEO based on outcomes verified after the contracting horizon. Restricting compensation to an interim signal yields a strict effort wedge relative to the full-commitment benchmark. The key comparative static is that the wedge is largest when the long-horizon outcome would have been most informative if contractible; that is, a more informative noncontractible long-horizon outcome does not close the gap. We also quantify the shareholder value of extending the contracting horizon. The implication is that climate-linked CEO pay can address the tragedy of the horizon only when the relevant metrics are both informative and contractible.
abstract_zh: 地平线悲剧”捕捉了长期气候损害与企业决策较短视野之间的差距。我们通过一个标准的CARA正态道德风险模型，对这一理念进行了契约层面的阐释。在完全承诺条件下，最优线性契约能够依据长期结果进行条件设定；仅凭视野错配并不足以导致投资不足。当股东今日无法可信地承诺依据契约期后验证的结果来补偿CEO时，悲剧便应运而生。将补偿限制于中期信号，相对于完全承诺基准，会产生严格的努力程度偏差。关键的比较静态分析显示，当长期结果若可契约化时最具信息量时，这一偏差达到最大；换言之，更具信息量的不可契约化长期结果并不能缩小这一差距。我们还量化了延长契约视野对股东价值的增益。其含义在于，只有当相关指标既具信息性又具可契约性时，与气候挂钩的CEO薪酬才能应对“地平线悲剧”。
title: The tragedy of the horizon: A contracting account
title_zh: 地平线的悲剧：一份契约解释

abstract: This study examines the effect of managerial responses assisted by generative artificial intelligence (GenAI) on stock price crash risk. Using question–response data from investor-relations platforms operated by Chinese stock exchanges, we employ large language models (LLMs) to measure the degree of GenAI assistance in managerial responses. We find that stronger GenAI-assisted textual features predict higher future stock price crash risk. We further show that greater response–question mismatch and more negative investor sentiment serve as two potential mechanisms, and that the effect is more pronounced among firms with more frequent investor interactions.
abstract_zh: 本研究探讨了生成式人工智能（GenAI）辅助的管理层回复对股价崩盘风险的影响。基于中国证券交易所投资者关系平台的问答数据，我们运用大语言模型（LLMs）测度管理层回复中GenAI辅助程度。研究发现，GenAI辅助文本特征越显著，未来股价崩盘风险越高。进一步分析表明，回复与问题匹配度降低及投资者负面情绪加剧是两条潜在作用机制，且该效应在投资者互动更频繁的企业中更为显著。
china_relevance_reason: 摘要仅出现一次中国相关表述，需确认中国是否为核心研究对象
title: Generative AI-assisted investor communication and stock price crash risk
title_zh: 生成式AI辅助投资者沟通与股价崩盘风险

abstract: We examine the impact of short-term temperature changes on voting behavior in the Brazilian presidential elections from 2010 to 2018, focusing on the candidacy of Marina Silva, a prominent pro-environment politician. Using data on municipality level voting and daily wet bulb temperature, we find that an increase in temperature on election day increases votes for Marina Silva. We argue that this effect is driven by the salience of climate change issues, which influences last-minute voting decisions. Our analysis also shows that temperature variations in the days preceding the election have a limited impact on voting outcomes, highlighting the transient nature of climate salience effects.
abstract_zh: 本文考察了2010年至2018年巴西总统选举期间短期气温变化对投票行为的影响，重点关注著名环保政治家玛丽娜·席尔瓦的竞选活动。利用市级投票数据与每日湿球温度数据，我们发现选举日气温升高会增加玛丽娜·席尔瓦的得票数。我们认为这一效应源于气候变化议题的显著性，这种显著性影响了选民在最后一刻的投票决策。分析还表明，选举前几天的气温变化对投票结果影响有限，凸显了气候显著性效应的短暂性特征。
title: Voting in the heat of the moment: Climate change salience and electoral behavior
title_zh: 气候变化紧迫性下的投票：气候突显性与选举行为

abstract: We develop a novel semantic-distance-based algorithm and apply it to job titles data to identify ``new work''---new types of jobs introduced in a labor market. Implementing these measures for the US (1980-2010), we show that the share of college-educated workers across occupations and locations is the strongest predictor of new work, even after controlling for technological change, trade, immigration, population aging, and agglomeration economies. Using pre-1920 land-grant colleges as instruments in matched treatment-control analyses, we find evidence consistent with a strong, positive causal effect of college-educated density on ``new work" creation. Complementary analysis based on Lightcast online vacancy data (2017-2022) confirms this pattern.
abstract_zh: 我们开发了一种基于语义距离的新算法，并将其应用于职位名称数据，以识别“新工作”——即劳动力市场中引入的新型职业类型。通过在美国（1980-2010年）实施这些度量，我们发现，即使在控制了技术变革、贸易、移民、人口老龄化和集聚经济等因素后，各职业和地区中受过大学教育的劳动者占比仍是新工作出现的最强预测因子。利用1920年前赠地学院作为工具变量，在匹配处理-对照分析中，我们发现了与大学教育密度对新工作创造具有强烈正向因果效应相一致的证据。基于Lightcast在线职位空缺数据（2017-2022年）的补充分析进一步证实了这一模式。
title: The Role of College Education in the Rise of ``New Work": Measurement and Evidence
title_zh: 大学教育在“新工作”兴起中的作用：测度与证据

abstract: Generative artificial intelligence (AI) is increasingly consuming and producing huge amounts of data. We propose a social learning model of AI, emphasizing a data-AI feedback loop: data quality affects AI productivity, which influences AI adoption and, consequently, the composition (AI versus human-generated) and quality of future data. Calibrated to evidence on synthetic training loops, the model predicts hump-shaped labor dynamics—short-term displacement that partially reverses as data quality deteriorates. A Grossman–Stiglitz-style externality emerges: AI adopters free-ride on the human-generated actions that supply the novel information on which AI itself relies. In a competitive market, AI should be taxed to correct the data-quality externality; a concentrated AI industry overcorrects, making a subsidy optimal. (JEL O33, D62, D83, J24)
abstract_zh: 摘要 生成式人工智能正日益消耗并产生海量数据。我们提出一个关于人工智能的社会学习模型，强调数据与人工智能之间的反馈循环：数据质量影响人工智能的生产力，进而影响人工智能的采用，并最终决定未来数据的构成（人工智能生成与人类生成）及其质量。基于合成训练循环的证据进行校准后，该模型预测劳动力动态呈驼峰形——短期替代效应会随着数据质量恶化而部分逆转。一种格罗斯曼-斯蒂格利茨式外部性由此产生：人工智能采用者搭便车，依赖人类生成的行为提供人工智能自身所需的新信息。在竞争性市场中，应对人工智能征税以纠正数据质量外部性；而集中化的人工智能行业则会过度纠正，使得补贴成为最优选择。（JEL O33, D62, D83, J24）
title: Generative AI and Data Quality: Implications for Productivity, Labor Displacement, and Policy
title_zh: 生成式人工智能与数据质量：对生产率、劳动力替代及政策的影响

abstract: Abstract Between 1807 and 1815, US imports of manufactured goods were slashed dramatically by a trade embargo, non‐importation measures, and the War of 1812. These disruptions are commonly believed to have promoted the growth of nascent domestic manufacturers and thereby spurred early US industrialization. This paper uses disaggregated data on US industrial production to investigate how this interruption of foreign competition affected domestic manufacturing. On balance, the trade disruptions did not accelerate US industrialization, as trend growth in industrial output was little changed over this period. However, the disruptions may have played a role in shifting resources, at least temporarily, from trade‐dependent industries (such as shipbuilding) to domestic infant industries (such as cotton textiles).
abstract_zh: 摘要 1807年至1815年间，贸易禁运、非进口措施及1812年战争导致美国制成品进口大幅削减。这些贸易中断通常被认为促进了新兴国内制造业的发展，从而推动了美国早期工业化。本文利用美国工业生产的细分数据，研究外国竞争的中断如何影响国内制造业。总体而言，贸易中断并未加速美国工业化，因为这一时期工业产出的趋势性增长几乎没有变化。然而，这些中断可能至少在短期内促使资源从依赖贸易的行业（如造船业）转向国内新兴行业（如棉纺织业）。
title: Trade disruptions and early US industrialization
title_zh: 贸易中断与美国早期工业化

abstract: Global imbalances are back in the policy debate. This column examines 70 current account adjustment episodes across 51 economies from 1980 to 2024 to discover how large imbalances have unwound in the past. Three lessons stand out: adjustments are fairly common but slow; deficit and surplus narrowing work through different channels; and larger imbalances – especially deficits – are significantly more likely to correct.
abstract_zh: 全球失衡问题重新成为政策辩论的焦点。本文考察了1980年至2024年间51个经济体的70次经常账户调整事件，以探究过去大规模失衡是如何化解的。三个关键启示值得关注：调整虽较为常见但进程缓慢；赤字与盈余的收窄通过不同渠道实现；规模较大的失衡——尤其是赤字——更有可能得到纠正。
authors: Erik Frohm, John Hooley, Fatih Ozturk, Lukasz Rawdanowicz, Nivetha Sivakumar
title: How large current account imbalances unwind: Evidence from historical adjustment episodes
title_zh: 经常账户失衡如何消退：来自历史调整时期的证据

abstract: Viticulture is a key economic sector in Europe, but responsible for vast amounts of fungicide use. Fungus‐resistant grapevine varieties are less susceptible to fungal diseases, reducing fungicide use by up to 80%. However, their adoption remains limited, despite their economic and environmental advantages. We develop a bio‐economic simulation model with a real options investment perspective to analyze farmers’ decisions to adopt resistant varieties, accounting for different risk factors (e.g., production, market, policy). We apply the model to the case of Swiss viticulture. Results indicate that in the short‐term, adoption barriers persist for the majority of farmers, with replanting occurring only when favorable conditions are met, such as low discount rates, high disease pressure, and available price premia. Conversely, we find that in the long‐term, as vines reach replacement age, resistant varieties are favored over traditional ones. Our findings further indicate that increases in disease pressure, for example, due to climate change, are likely to accelerate the early adoption of fungus‐resistant varieties. We highlight potential avenues for improving current support for replanting in Switzerland, for example, through market access and information provision. By integrating risk and managerial flexibility into a dynamic, real options decision‐making framework, this study provides new insights for designing effective policies to promote sustainable pest management in viticulture.
abstract_zh: 葡萄栽培是欧洲重要的经济部门，但也是大量杀菌剂使用的来源。抗真菌葡萄品种对真菌病害的敏感性较低，可将杀菌剂使用量减少高达80%。然而，尽管具有经济和环境优势，其采用率仍然有限。我们构建了一个结合实物期权投资视角的生物经济模拟模型，用于分析农户采纳抗性品种的决策，并考虑了不同风险因素（如生产、市场、政策）。我们将该模型应用于瑞士葡萄栽培案例。结果表明，短期内，大多数农户仍面临采用障碍，只有在满足低贴现率、高病害压力和可获得溢价等有利条件时才会进行重新种植。相反，我们发现长期来看，当葡萄藤达到更新树龄时，抗性品种比传统品种更受青睐。我们的研究进一步表明，病害压力的增加（例如因气候变化所致）可能加速抗真菌品种的早期采用。我们指出了改善瑞士当前重新种植支持政策的潜在途径，例如通过市场准入和信息提供。通过将风险和管理灵活性纳入动态的实物期权决策框架，本研究为设计促进葡萄栽培可持续病虫害管理的有效政策提供了新见解。
title: Adoption Dynamics of Fungus‐Resistant Grapevine Varieties: A Real Options Approach
title_zh: 抗真菌葡萄品种的采用动态：一种实物期权方法

abstract: This study examined the effect of the West‐to‐East Electricity Transmission Project in China on agricultural productivity. The project transmits electricity from the resource‐rich west to the consumer‐dense east. Using a Difference‐in‐Differences approach, we found that the project increased county‐level agricultural productivity by about USD 509.5 per person. This increase results from advances in agricultural technological progress and the development of the agricultural industry. Farmer adaptation to improved electricity supply also contributed, such as expanded irrigation, greater land allocation to water‐intensive crops, higher replanting indices, and larger‐scale operations. The project has also raised grain yields and farmers’ disposable incomes, while reducing the agricultural labor force. Only electricity transmission, not natural gas or oil, had a positive and significant effect on agricultural productivity. These results support compelling evidence for investing in large‐scale transregional electricity transmission infrastructure worldwide.
abstract_zh: 本研究考察了中国“西电东送”工程对农业生产率的影响。该工程将电力从资源丰富的西部地区输送至人口密集的东部地区。采用双重差分法，我们发现该工程使县级农业生产率人均提高了约509.5美元。这一增长源于农业技术进步和农业产业发展。农民对电力供应改善的适应性调整也起到了促进作用，例如扩大灌溉面积、增加高耗水作物的土地配置、提高复种指数以及扩大经营规模。该工程还提高了粮食产量和农民可支配收入，同时减少了农业劳动力。只有电力传输（而非天然气或石油）对农业生产率产生了显著的正向影响。这些结果为全球范围内投资大规模跨区域电力传输基础设施提供了有力证据。
